lede: Dallas Cowboys carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#8 in EPA per play), while Arizona Cardinals owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#28 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Dallas Cowboys −6.0 with a fair total of 52.0 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Dallas Cowboys pass offence vs Arizona Cardinals pass defence, which sits +0.218 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
